notes.title: Fresh Features: Shop Upgrades, Weather, Rage, and More!
notes.notes:
A new update is here for you to enjoy! Check out the most important changes:

[list]
[*] Rebuy last 15 items you’ve sold at the shop anytime.
[*] Experience weather: rain, snow, and even acid rain!
[*] Build up rage in combat for extra power.
[*] Light up dark dungeons with your trusty torch.
[/list]

notes.title: New Icons & Fresh Content in Deep Forest and Graveyard
notes.notes:
These are the updates for this release:

[list]
[*] The reward icon has been revamped
[*] Dynamic icon rendering is now more responsive
[*] Fresh Content in Deep Forest and Graveyard!
[/list]

notes.title: Realm Renaissance: Expansive Terrains, Nexus Relay & Map Overhaul
notes.notes: [p]Thanks for sticking with MudGate while I chip away at the rough edges![/p][p][/p][p]Over the past few months I’ve focused on three things: polishing how it plays (including a slicker mini-map), streamlining tutorials, and implementing performance fixes. [/p][p][/p][p]Every change is aimed at making your sessions smoother.[/p][p][/p][p]This update also lays the groundwork for me to focus on more content, so expect fresh questlines, additional terrain, and deeper functionality for the Nexus Relay in the near future.[/p][p]Your feedback keeps the forge hot, so keep it coming and I’ll keep delivering.[/p][p][/p][p]See you in the realms, and thanks for playing MudGate![/p][p][/p][p]What I’ve updated so far:[/p][p][/p][h3]Realm[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]The Nexus Server Relay is now online and sends game events out to each realm that is connected.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowbird Forest and Icemire now has brand-new terrain, secrets, and monster species.[/p][/*][*][p]A mysterious wizard NPC has appeared near Icemire’s portal hub.[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeon revamp: smarter NPC distribution and several brand-new dungeon inhabitants.[/p][/*][*][p]Combat clarity: weapon damage numbers now pop over enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance pass on gear: invalid equipment bonuses purged; Item-Bonus-Effects generator fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New Features[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]One-click expandable mini-map, plus optional direction markers and a live camera-rotation icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Window control: Ctrl + R — quick resize • F11 — instant fullscreen • Esc — toggles system menu[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory icons regenerated for sharper visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Cloud sync and a Chromium rendering engine for smoother, cross-device play.[/p][list][*][p]Linux and Mac not verified yet.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tutorial streamlined (new “Interactive Commands” step, anchored window).[/p][/*][*][p]MudGate now shows in-world date/time, keeping everyone on the same timeline.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Most Important Bug Fixes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Skull-bomb objective and Aid/Adrenaline now trigger correctly even at 0 HP/Energy.[/p][/*][*][p]Stuck-NPC movement bug eliminated.[/p][/*][*][p]Rare inventory-icon loading failure and bag-inside-bag exploit resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Effects now always clear when they expire or when you change realms.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple performance boosts and tighter error handling across client and server.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Window Resizing, Inventory Icon Improvements
notes.notes:
These are the changes for this update:

[list]
[*] Added "Ctrl + R" shortcut to resize the game window.
[*] Updated the inventory icon generator.
[*] Fixed an issue where inventory icons were not being loaded.
[/list]

notes.title: Minimap markers and bug-fixes
notes.notes:
Here’s what’s new in this release:

[list]
[*] Add minimap direction markers (can be toggled)
[*] The minimap icon now shows camera rotation
[*] Fix an issue with the skull bomb objective (was broken)
[*] Fix a bug with Aid/Adrenaline when energy or health was 0
[/list]

notes.title: Nexus Relay Launch
notes.notes:
Nexus Relay is now live with a basic set of features, and more features and events will become available as chapter one continues.

Changes in this update:

[list]
[*] The stand-highlight effect has been toned down for a smoother visual experience.
[*] Nexus Relay is now live, allowing players to access its features in-game.
[*] MudGate now displays both date and time (use the date/time command).
[*] The Item-Bonus-Effects Generator has been fixed.
[*] Invalid equipment bonuses have been removed for improved balance.
[/list]

notes.title: Dungeon Updates, New NPCs, and Performance Improvements
notes.notes:
This update brings improved dungeons with better NPC distribution, new NPCs, and visible weapon damage numbers during combat. My upcoming updates will focus on the Nexus Relay saga and the launch of Chapter One!

These are the updates for this release:

[list]
[*] Updated dungeons with improved NPC distribution.
[*] Added new NPCs to dungeons.
[*] Added a new icon for unknown objectives.
[*] The tutorial window is now fixed to the right side.
[*] Improved overall performance.
[*] Enhanced animation transitions.
[*] Added effect cleanup when changing realms.
[*] Weapon damage numbers are now displayed when combating NPCs.
[/list]

notes.title: Nexus Stone Update
notes.notes:
Here are the latest changes and improvements:

[list]
[*] Added the Nexus Stone
[*] Reduced health for low-level NPCs
[*] Improved visibility of objects with objectives
[*] Enhanced overall performance
[*] Improved error handling 
[/list]

notes.title: Chromium Transition and Steam Cloud Support
notes.notes:
I’ve transitioned from WebView2 to Chromium to improve compatibility. I’ve also added migration scripts to ensure your existing game data is preserved during this update. 

Additionally, Steam Cloud support has been implemented, so your progress and settings will sync across devices.

Changes in this update:

[list]
[*] MudGate World Date & Time is now set relative to March 21, 2025 (the release date).
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs did not move properly in the world.
[*] Added support for Steam Cloud.
[*] Replaced WebView2 with Chromium.
[*] Added migration scripts for existing data.
[*] Character names now allow spaces, punctuation (.-_), and accented characters.
[/list]

notes.title: Dungeon Visibility, Party Notifications & More
notes.notes:
Here's a summary of the latest changes and improvements implemented in MudGate:

[list]
[*]   The "To the Surface" sign is now visible on all dungeon levels.
[*]   Fixed an issue where the "Invalid Use" message was sometimes displayed twice.
[*]   Parties will now be notified if a member enters a private realm.
[*]   Realm information in the log window is now only displayed when clicked.
[*]   Primal Senses has been updated:
[list]
[*]   Now hints once for nearby interactable objects.
[*]   Now provides a dexterity bonus.
[*]   Now lasts until canceled.
[*]   Now costs 1 energy per round.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: UI Improvements, World Updates, and Ability Adjustments
notes.notes:
This update focuses on enhancing the gameplay experience, refining abilities, and improving the environment, and I welcome all player feedback and suggestions :-)

These are the updates:

[list]
[*] Minor UI Improvements: Adjustments made to enhance the first gameplay experience.
[*] Escape Key Functionality: Pressing "Escape" now toggles the system menu.
[*] Abilities Usage Messages: Improved clarity for ability-related messages.
[*] Environment Updates: Dungeons & Lowbird Forest have been updated.
[*] Shadow Stalker Class Updates:

[list]
[*]  Dark Harvest: Increased empowerment gained per kill.
[*]  Vampiric Shadows: Slightly reduced weapon siphon effects.
[*] Poisonous Dagger: Now cause greater movement impairment on opponents.
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: MudGate: Enhancements, New Features, and Fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Enhanced error handling and compatibility for the MudGate App.
[*] Added a new "Interactive Commands" step to the tutorial.
[*] Fixed a bug where effects were not being removed properly.
[*] Resolved an issue that allowed bags to be placed inside other bags.
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life Update (24 March 25)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added support for toggling fullscreen mode with the F11 key.
[*] Simplified the tutorial to make it quicker and easier to complete.
[/list]

notes.title: Paths Reconnected – Part 1 & 2
notes.notes:
I am excited to bring you Paths Reconnected – Part 1 & 2, the latest major update in the ongoing series. This update continues to reshape the world of MudGate, introducing new terrain for exploration and restoration. 

As the world awakens, paths long lost to time have been reshaped, revealing valuable treasures. Remember, not all treasures are visible in plain sight—some may require searching and even text commands to uncover.

For a full list of all changes, please see the "Bulletins" in the MudGate Game Application.

[b]Demo hint:[/b]
Invite a guest to play on your local network in-game: "SOCIAL" -> "Create or Join Game."


[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] World Changes: New lands have been added to the following realms:
[list]
[*]  Bone Sea
[*]  Hanging Cliffs
[*]  Triset Forest
[*]  Moaning Highlands
[*]  Miserable Lands
[*]  Icemire
[*]  Lowbird Forest
[/list][*] New NPCs: Added NPCs with unique offensive and defensive abilities.
[*] New Equipment: Discover powerful new gear to aid your journey.
[*] New Player Commands:
[list]
[*] Party: Form groups with other players
[*] Wimpy: Automatically flee when health is low
[*] Flee: Manually escape from combat
[/list][/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs would not properly interact with newly restored terrain
[*] Fixed an issue with multiplayer synchronization during public realm exploration
[*] Ghosts can no longer interact with inventory or game objects
[*] Several minor fixes to main story objectives
[*] Minor tweaks to improve playability and UI
[/list]

[h2]Technical Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Game files are now created temporarily and moved instead of being saved over the current file
[*] Updated the web renderer to Babylon.js v7.50.0
[/list]

[b]Enjoy the new adventures, and happy exploring![/b]
